texts.preamble: Ramashankar Keshari vs State Of U.P. on 21 July, 2023
texts.arguments: Counsel for Applicant :- Brajesh Kumar Solanki Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A. Hon'ble Vikas Budhwar,J. Heard Brajesh Kumar Solanki, learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the material brought on record. This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed to direct the court below to consider and decide the bail application of the applicant in Case No. 805 of 2004 (State vs. Ramashankar Keshari), under Section - 7/16 Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, Police Station - Koraon, District - Allahabad, expeditiously. Learned counsel for the applicant, as per the instructions received by him, submits that the only prayer which he is pressing is for getting the bail application of the applicant decided.
